meanings.note: Only on the telephone. Spoken French interj expression meaning 'hello', common in natural conversation.

meanings.note: For people use 'amener'. Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to bring'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'apporté').

examples.text: J'ai apporté cinq exemplaires des contrats.
examples.trans: I've brought five copies of the contracts.

meanings.note: S'asseoir sur une chaise. French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire'). Core French verb meaning 'to sit down, to seat'.

examples.text: On essayait de rester assis au fond.

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'seated'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

meanings.note: Invariable French adverb meaning 'today'; placed immediately after the conjugated verb in simple tenses.
